articles.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
articles.snippet: The breach hit an internal employee system that Bithumb says is separate from its trading platform, while the exchange is still determining whether customer information was exposed.

articles.title: Coinbase says user funds are safe after third-party vendor exposes customer contact info
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange says an incident at analytics firm Amplitude exposed some customer contact information, but insists its own systems were not breached.

articles.title: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
articles.snippet: Each day brings news of another AI-powered attack, or a newly discovered vulnerability. Here’s what’s happening and how ordinary people can protect themselves online.

articles.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data
articles.snippet: Coinbase said that an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed some customers’ contact data, but it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems.

articles.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
articles.snippet: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.
